manifest.name: tabellio-dsh
manifest.description: DeepSeek Harness native adapter for tabellio: budgeted auto-recall, native memory tools, and explicit-clue candidates. The memory core stays in tabellio.
manifest.author: yffto

bundle.text:
# tabellio for DeepSeek Harness.
#
# The plugin is a host adapter, not a second memory system: notes, index,
# gates, receipts and consolidation all stay in the tabellio package. This
# layer only adds DSH-native tools, budgeted auto-recall at the start of a
# user turn, and candidate capture at turn/session end.
#
# Everything is local: it only talks to a local embedding service, no cloud and no
# daemon of its own. Judge uses the host's current default model (opt-out with `judge: off`).
#
# 这里只钉「产品选择」，不钉「库默认值」。
# DSH 的 patch 是整段替换 config：写在这儿的每个键都会盖掉 src/config.js 的默认，
# 而且写下的旧值不会随插件升级自动更新。2026-10-22 就因为这里钉了
# recallBudgetTokens: 500 / recallMaxNotes: 6 / recallMinCoverage: 0.33，
# 所有新装用户拿到的是 A/B 之前的召回配置（120 题模拟用户库答对 63.7%），
# 而插件 0.39.x 的默认是 76.3%。
# 所以预算、阈值、judge、semantic 一律不写；test/patch.test.mjs 会强制检查
# 「这里只能是库默认值，或白名单里的产品选择」。
- insert:
    - id: tabellio
      name: tabellio-dsh
      config:
        enabled: true
        # 显式线索 + 纠正类线索 + 陈述式约定（「我一般…」「记住…」），仍只写候选，
        # 批准后才入库。库默认 `explicit` 更窄；「装完即用」的产品档位选 assist。
        # 数据位置跟库默认：~/memory/tabellio（安装后在「设置 → 记忆」可见）。
        capture: assist
        # 静默投递：命中的笔记作为运行时上下文进入 system prompt，不往对话里插插件消息。
        # 想看到「这次想起了什么」再切 `notice`（面板可改，不用重启）。
        delivery: context

readme.text: [English](README.en.md) | 简体中文 **给 DeepSeek Harness 加一个「记得住、但你说了算」的记忆。**

它会在聊天里留意值得留下的约定和偏好：显式说「记住/以后都」且长期、单主题的低风险约定，经一次写侧裁决后直接记住；其余先收进「候选区」等你批准。之后你问「我们上次怎么定的？」，它会自己想起来。 数据全部存在你电脑上的普通 Markdown 文件里，不上传；联网只发生在**本机回环**：自动发现本地向量服务（`semantic: auto`），以及用宿主当前模型做一次「相关/不相关」的小裁决（`judge: llm`，可关）。

---

新开一个对话，Agent 就失忆了：你昨天说过的偏好、定过的流程、纠正过的错误，它一概不记得。

市面上的记忆插件大多两种做法：要么什么都不记，要么把整段对话一股脑塞进记忆里——结果不是没帮上忙，就是把无关内容也召回、干扰回答。

tabellio-dsh 走第三条路：**先草稿，后记忆**。它只把「看起来值得记」的话写成候选；你批准了才入库。入库的每条记忆都能查到来源，召回有预算、有上限，不会淹没对话。

readme.section: 它和别的记忆插件有什么不一样
readme.text:
- **默认只自动记低风险。** T0（显式「记住/以后都」+ 持久 + 单主题 + 无凭据/冲突）经写侧裁决后入库；一次性、凭据、冲突、观点仍进候选，批准权在你。删除、修改也永远在你手里。
- **召回看得见、说得清。** 设置里的「记忆」页会告诉你上一轮为什么想起（或没想起）什么，而不是黑箱。
- **纯本地、纯文本。** 记忆就是 `~/memory/tabellio` 下的 Markdown 文件，用任何编辑器都能看；换电脑拷走就能用。

需要 DeepSeek Harness `0.2.x`。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add tabellio-dsh
```

装完**重启 DSH**。打开「设置 → 记忆」，能看到笔记数、候选数和库路径就成功了。

> **从 0.39.1 及更早升级？** 那些版本的安装补丁把召回预算钉在 `500 token / 6 条 / 覆盖率 0.33`。如果你的 `~/.dsh/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml` 里也有这三行（`recallBudgetTokens`、`recallMaxNotes`、`recallMinCoverage`），删掉让它们跟随 0.39.2 的默认（`1200 / 8 / 0.2`）；不删会继续用旧预算，面板上看不出来。

> 还在开发版？用本地目录安装：`dsh plugin --profile desktop add /path/to/tabellio-dsh`。

1. **正常聊天。** 说一句「以后发布前先跑测试」或「我不喜欢太长的回答」。
2. **打开「设置 → 记忆」**，在候选区点「批准入库」。
3. **过几天问它一句**：「我们发布前一般先做什么？」——它会自己想起来。

想跳过对话直接写？「设置 → 记忆」里有一个「直接存一条记忆」的输入框，保存即入库。

就这么多。不需要每次说「请记住」，也不需要配置任何东西。

``` 你说的话 │ ① 留意约定、偏好、纠错（每轮最多 2 条） ▼ 候选区 notes/candidates/ ← 只在这里，还没进记忆

几个你可能会关心的点：

- **新窗口不再从空白开始。** 会话第一条如果是「继续/开工」这类没有主题的话，会带上 1–2 条最近更新的项目笔记（每会话一次，最多 900 字）；shadow 模式不生效。
- **候选会被提醒一次。** 有候选等你批准时，静默上下文里会多一行提示（每 6 小时最多一次），点开设置页「记忆」逐条确认即可。
- **默认只花一次小模型调用。** 召回命中时，用你正在用的 DSH 默认模型做一次很小的相关度判断；全部本地语义可用，不向外部发数据。想完全关掉：面板「设置 → 智能记忆」关掉即可。
- **不会把整段对话存下来。** 只挑约定、偏好、纠错这类「值得长期记住」的句子。
- **不会把密码写进去。** 出现明文密码、token 的句子直接跳过；「凭据统一放 1Password」这种策略句才会保留。
- **不会打扰闲聊。** 只有问题像是在问「我们的历史/约定/偏好」时，才会把记忆带进上下文。

**Q：装完为什么一条记忆都没有？**
它只在出现值得记的话时才产生候选；新库本来就是空的。聊几天就有了。

**Q：为什么候选一直不消失？**
T0 显式长期约定会自动入库，其余候选需要你批准（或忽略）才会离开候选区；Agent 不会替你批准 T1/T2——这是故意的。

**Q：记忆存在哪里？能备份吗？**
`~/memory/tabellio`。整个目录拷走就是备份；删掉索引也能从 Markdown 重建。

**Q：能关掉自动捕获吗？**
能。设置里把 `capture` 改成 `off`，或只保留 `explicit`（必须说出「记住」才记）。

**Q：会不会拖慢对话？**
召回只在每轮第一条真人消息时做一次，默认 1200 token 预算、最多 8 条（2026-10-22 由 500/6 复测上调：太小等于把第 3 名以后的 gold 直接裁掉）；闲聊直接跳过。

**Q：支持 Claude Code / Cursor 吗？**
核心库和命令行工具支持多个宿主；DSH 插件目前只适配 DSH。其他宿主的适配在路线图上。

普通用户不用动。想微调的话，在 DSH 的 profile 配置里改这几项就够：

| 开关 | 默认 | 一句话 |
|---|---|---|
| `autoApprove` | `t0` | 默认开：显式且长期的单主题约定（T0）在 `writeJudge: llm` 真返回裁决后自动入库；设为 `off` 恢复全人工。 |
| `capture` | `assist` | 记什么：`assist` 最省心；`explicit` 只记「记住…」；`off` 关闭 |
| `delivery` | `context` | 怎么送：`context` 静默（推荐）；`notice` 在对话里显示一条提示 |
| `shadow` | `false` | 只记录召回、不注入，用来对比其他记忆插件 |
| `judge` | `llm` | 用模型再筛一遍召回，更准；每轮命中时多一次小调用 |
| `storePath` | `~/memory/tabellio` | 记忆放在哪 |

其余高级配置见[开发者说明](#给开发者)。
> 上表是插件补丁（`cordis.patch.yml`）下发的默认值；配置里不写这些键时，代码内置默认是 `capture: explicit`、`delivery: notice`。

每轮召回命中时多一次小模型调用：把「问题 + 最多 4 条候选」一起给模型，只留真正回答问题的笔记。默认开启，模型**永远跟随宿主当前选中的对话模型**（换模型即跟着换，不需要单独配置）；想省成本，在面板「设置 → 智能记忆」里关掉。需要固定模型的进阶用户仍可在配置文件写 `judgeModel`/`judgeProvider`。裁决失败一律放行，不会因为模型超时丢记忆。

真实模型抽样（本地 Qwen3.6-35B，30 条冻结问句 + 人工 gold）：gold 召回 19/20，judge 后保留 18/19（94.7%），保留笔记里 85.7% 是相关项；1 条 gold 被误杀、1 条无关笔记被留下、1 次格式失败按「失败即放行」回退。这是 2026-10-19 的快照，不是长期承诺。

- 词面召回：p50 约 131ms、p95 约 225ms（本机 M 系列，冷/热进程混合）。
- 叠加本地语义补召回：p50 约 166ms、p95 约 312ms；语义服务离线时自动退回词面，不阻塞。
- 模型裁决只在命中后调用一次，实测 1.0–1.3s（deepseek-flash）；把它关掉就只花上面的时间。
- 复测：`TABELLIO_STORE=~/memory/tabellio npm run bench:recall`（只读，不写库）。

readme.section: 设置面板（设置 → 记忆）
readme.text:
第一次打开面板会走三步引导（默认开启智能记忆 → 选本机或远程向量服务 → 存第一条记忆试试），也可以「稍后再说」，之后在「设置」页底部点「重新运行引导」再走一遍。

面板按任务分成四个页签，状态不会一次铺满：

readme.section: 设置面板（设置 → 记忆）
readme.text:
- **概览**：记忆总量 / 待批准 / 索引状态，加上「上次召回」、最近 7 天汇总（召回次数、注入成本、裁决保留/丢弃、复核、新增记忆）、最近召回记录（为什么召回/为什么没召回，用人话写）、「裁决复核」（模型每次裁决保留/丢弃了哪些记忆，可点「判得对 / 判错了」抽样复核）、「记忆成本」（近 7 天注入字符/估算 tokens/裁决与语义调用次数）与最近新增；
- **待批准**：新候选与合并提案，可单条或批量批准/忽略，只有批准后才进 notes/；
- **记忆库**：写一条新记忆、搜索并点开全文（正文下方附「来源与使用」：写入来源、信任级别、是否被取代、被召回次数，以及一条时间线——写入、哪几轮被召回、被你纠正/标记、被谁取代）、全部笔记翻页与类型/时间筛选；
- **设置**：只有一个「智能记忆」开关（开=自动发现本地向量服务 + 用默认模型过滤误召回；关=纯词面）。服务地址/模型、捕获档位、投递方式、每轮条数、巩固节奏都收在「进阶设置」里，保存即生效；judge 模型与耗时、语义索引大小、库路径、索引警告收在同一页下方。

readme.section: 设置面板（设置 → 记忆）
readme.text:
普通用户不用碰配置文件：面板里只决定一件事——**智能记忆**开不开（默认开）。开启后自动探测本机常见向量端口（llama-swap / Ollama / LM Studio 等），发现即用；没有任何向量服务时自动退回词面匹配，不会报错。地址、模型、捕获档位、投递方式、每轮条数、巩固节奏，以及「助手结论沉淀」「纠正反馈」两个开关都在「进阶设置」里，保存即生效。这些写在记忆库目录的 `panel-settings.json`，可随库迁移，也不会动宿主配置。

**裁决模型不用配**：judge 始终用你当前对话里选中的模型，换模型自动跟着换；只有想长期固定某个模型时才需要改配置文件（`judgeModel`）。

readme.section: 设置面板（设置 → 记忆）
readme.text:
**用远程向量服务？** 在「进阶设置」里把服务地址指向任意 OpenAI 风格的 `/v1/embeddings`，点「获取模型」从服务端拉模型列表（也可以手填），再点「测试连接」确认维度和耗时；远程服务需要填 API Key（写进 `panel-settings.json`，明文本地文件），更推荐用环境变量 `TABELLIO_SEMANTIC_API_KEY`，面板里会显示「已设置」而不会回显 Key。

留在配置里的只有进阶项：`recallMinRelevance`/`recallMinScore`/`recallMinCoverage`（召回阈值）、`recallBudgetTokens`、`storePath`、`shadow`、`refreshSeconds`。这些改错会直接影响召回质量或落库位置，所以没有放进面板；默认值已经适配普通用户。

readme.section: 纠正会被记住（结果反馈）
readme.text:
记忆注入之后的下一轮，如果你说「不对，应该是白鹭」这类**纠正**，而这句话又和刚注入的笔记
有实际词面重叠（至少 2 个共同词元），插件会往 `outcome.jsonl` 记一条局部信号：哪几条笔记被
纠正、当时问的什么。之后这些笔记只在同一查询的排序里小幅降权（每条最多降 24%），不删除、
不改写、不越过相关性闸门；超过 10 分钟或不相关的「不对」不会被算到记忆头上。
关掉：`outcomeFeedback: false`。

归因在 36 条合成对抗样本上实测：precision 0.923、recall 1.0（1 条误归因是「同一主题、不同方面」；见 `node tools/outcome-eval.mjs`）。这是合成集，真实会话的准确率还要再量。

- 全部本地读写；网络只到 `127.0.0.1`（本地向量服务），以及宿主默认模型的一次裁决调用（可关）。
- 不收集任何遥测。
- 明文 Markdown，建议放在你自己的加密磁盘里。

<details>
<summary>点开：架构、工具面、配置全表、测试与评测</summary>

- **核心 `tabellio`**：存储、索引、BM25 + 共现打分、写入闸门、回执、巩固。这个插件只做 DSH 适配，不复制核心逻辑。
- **适配层 `tabellio-dsh`**：`agent/pre-step` 召回、`agent/turn-stopping` 捕获、7 个原生工具、设置面板（HTTP RPC，loopback + Origin 校验；概览/待批准/记忆库/设置四个页签）。
- 换宿主时核心不动，只换适配层；库目录、写入闸门、召回口径三个入口共用，走查见 [docs/CROSS-HOST.md](docs/CROSS-HOST.md)。

`tabellio_recall` / `tabellio_search` / `tabellio_read` / `tabellio_status` / `tabellio_capture` / `tabellio_inbox` / `tabellio_report`（周报）/ `tabellio_conflicts`（只读：列出可能过时的笔记对）/ `tabellio_merge`（人批准后合并新旧说法，旧笔记标记被取代）/ `tabellio_feedback`（记录「这条有用 / 不对」，只调整后续排序，不改笔记）/ `tabellio_forget`（人确认后归档一条笔记，自动召回不再使用；文件保留可审计）/ `tabellio_edit`（人要求修改时写入新版本并标记旧版本被取代，自动召回切到新版本）。`tabellio_recall` 与 `tabellio_search` 支持 `as_of` 按某个时间点查询。工具与 CLI、MCP 共用同一套预算、拒答和写入闸门。

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | 关闭后不注册工具、不挂事件 |
| `storePath` | `~/memory/tabellio` | 与 CLI/MCP 同一个库，支持 `~` |
| `autoRecall` | `true` | 每轮首个真人消息召回一次 |
| `shadow` | `false` | 只写回执不注入，用于 A/B |
| `delivery` | `notice` | `notice` 可见通知；`context` 静默上下文 |
| `recallBudgetTokens` | `1200` | 召回预算，100–4000（太小时第 3 名以后的 gold 会被裁掉） |
| `recallMaxNotes` | `8` | 最多几条，1–20 |
| `injectMaxChars` | `1400` | 一轮注入的字符上限（约合 450 token），超出时只保留前几条全文 |
| `injectFullNotes` | `2` | 前几条给全文；后续条目只给标题 + 120 字摘要，全文用 `tabellio_read` 取 |
| `injectRepeat` | `session` | 同一会话里已经注入过的笔记不重复注入；`turn` 只压住紧挨着的一轮，`off` 关闭 |
| `recallIntentGate` | `true` | 没有记忆意图的问句不注入 |
| `recallConfidentRelevance` | `0.9` | 首条相关度到这条线时，即使没有意图词也放行 |
| `feedbackRanking` | `true` | 用「有用 / 不对」反馈给召回结果做小幅重排（不增删笔记；事件存核心的 `<store>/runs/feedback.jsonl`） |
| `decayDays` | `180` | 遗忘衰减半衰期（天）；`0` 关闭。只压排序，不归档 |
| `decayFloor` | `0.6` | 衰减下限（0–1）；`user_stated` 与 `evergreen` 笔记不衰减 |
| `captureAssistant` | `false` | 每轮结束时把助手给出的结论/决定（含结论、以后、统一等线索）整理成一条候选，仍需你批准；默认关。 |
| `bootstrapRecall` | `true` | 新会话第一条是「继续/开工」这类无主题话时，带上最近 1–2 条项目笔记（每会话一次）。 |
| `bootstrapNotes` | `2` | 接续时最多带几条笔记，1–4。 |
| `bootstrapDays` | `30` | 只取最近 N 天更新过的笔记，1–365。 |
|

```bash
npm test                      # 74 个单元/集成用例 + npm run check:cross-host
node tests/acceptance.mjs     # 30 条功能验收
node tools/cross-host-demo.mjs  # 跨宿主 API 走查（临时库）
npm run check:cross-host       # 插件 API / CLI / MCP 三方一致性（临时库，失败即非零退出）

发布前四路独立测试报告归档在 `~/yffto/archive/2026-10/scratch/tabellio-dsh-validation/final/`。

- 不自动批准 T1/T2 候选；T0 显式约定按 `autoApprove` 自动入库。不自动合并/衰减/删除笔记。
- 不伪造 DSH 生命周期事件。
- 不上传；只访问本机回环服务（向量、宿主模型）。

</details>

**Memory for DeepSeek Harness that remembers — and still lets you decide.**

It watches the conversation for agreements and preferences worth keeping: a narrow T0 class (an explicit "remember this / from now on" that is durable and single-topic) is stored after one write-side check; everything else lands in the *candidate inbox* for you to approve. Days later, ask "how did we decide that?" and it remembers on its own.

Everything lives in plain Markdown files on your own machine. Nothing is uploaded; network traffic stays on loopback — discovering a local embedding service (`semantic: auto`) and one small relevant/not-relevant judge call with the host's current model (`judge: llm`, can be turned off).

---

Open a new conversation and the agent has amnesia: the preferences you mentioned yesterday, the workflow you agreed on, the mistake you corrected — all gone.

Most memory plugins go one of two ways: remember nothing, or dump entire conversations into a memory store. Either way you end up with noise: irrelevant hits bleed into answers, or nothing useful comes back at all.

tabellio-dsh takes a third path: **low-risk memory is automatic, everything else is draft-first.** Explicit durable conventions (T0) are checked on the write side and stored; one-offs, credentials and conflicts go to the candidate inbox. Every stored memory keeps its provenance, and recall has a budget and a cap so it never floods the conversation.

readme.section: What makes it different from other memory plugins
readme.text:
- **Default: only low-risk memory is automatic.** T0 explicit conventions are stored after a write-side check; one-offs, credentials, conflicts and opinions stay candidates until you approve them. Deleting and editing stay in your hands.
- **Recall is visible and explainable.** The Memory page under Settings tells you why the last turn recalled something — or why it did not.
- **Local and plain text.** Memory is just Markdown under `~/memory/tabellio`, readable in any editor and portable to another machine.

Requires DeepSeek Harness `0.2.x`.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add tabellio-dsh
```

**Restart DSH** afterwards. Open "Settings → Memory": if you can see the note count, candidate count and store path, it is working.

> **Upgrading from 0.39.1 or earlier?** Those releases pinned the recall budget at `500 tokens / 6 notes / coverage 0.33` in the bundle patch. If your `~/.dsh/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml` carries `recallBudgetTokens`, `recallMaxNotes` or `recallMinCoverage`, delete those lines so they follow 0.39.2 defaults (`1200 / 8 / 0.2`); otherwise the old budget keeps winning and nothing in the panel shows it.
> On a development build? Install from a local directory: `dsh plugin --profile desktop add /path/to/tabellio-dsh`.

readme.section: First run: three things to do
readme.text:
1. **Chat normally.** Say "run the tests before every release" or "I don't like long answers".
2. **Open "Settings → Memory"**: a T0 convention is already stored; remaining candidates wait for your **Approve**.
3. **Ask about it a few days later**: "what do we usually do before a release?" — it remembers.

That is all. No "please remember this" every time, no configuration required.

``` what you say │ ① spot agreements, preferences, corrections (max 2 per turn) ▼ candidate inbox notes/candidates/ ← drafts only, not memory yet

Things you may care about:

- **One nudge for waiting candidates.** When candidates are waiting for approval, the quiet context adds one line (at most once every six hours); open Settings → Memory to approve them.
- **One small model call by default.** When recall hits, the current DSH default model makes one tiny relevance decision. To spend nothing, switch off "Smart memory" under Settings. No data leaves your machine except that host-model call.
- **It does not store whole conversations.** It only picks sentences like agreements, preferences and corrections that are worth remembering long-term.
- **It does not write down passwords.** Sentences containing a plaintext password or token are skipped; policy lines such as "credentials live in 1Password" are kept.
- **It leaves small talk alone.** Memory is only brought into context when the question looks like it is about your history, agreements or preferences.

**Q: Why is the store empty after installing?**
It only produces candidates when something worth keeping appears; a fresh store is empty by design. Chat for a few days.

**Q: Why do candidates never disappear?**
Candidates leave the inbox only after you approve or dismiss them. The agent never approves on your behalf — that is deliberate.

**Q: Where is memory stored? Can I back it up?**
`~/memory/tabellio`. Copy the whole directory and you have a backup; even if you delete the index, it can be rebuilt from the Markdown files.

**Q: Can I turn off auto-capture?**
Yes. Set `capture` to `off` in Settings, or keep only `explicit` (it records only when you actually say "remember").

**Q: Does it slow conversations down?**
Recall runs once per turn, on the first human message, with a 1200-token budget and a cap of 8 notes (raised from 500/6 on 2026-10-22: too small a budget simply cuts gold below rank 2); small talk is skipped entirely.

**Q: Does it work with Claude Code / Cursor?**
The core library and CLI support multiple hosts; the DSH plugin currently adapts DSH only. Other host adapters are on the roadmap.

| Switch | Default | One line |
|---|---|---|
| `capture` | `assist` | What to remember: `assist` is easiest; `explicit` records only when you say "remember…"; `off` disables |
| `delivery` | `context` | How to deliver: `context` is silent (recommended); `notice` shows a message in the chat |
| `shadow` | `false` | Record recalls without injecting, to compare against other memory plugins |
| `judge` | `llm` | Re-check recalls with a model: more accurate, one small call per hit |
| `storePath` | `~/memory/tabellio` | Where memory lives |

All other advanced settings are in the [developer notes](#for-developers).

The optional switches above show the defaults shipped by the plugin patch (`cordis.patch.yml`). When a key is absent from the config, the code defaults are `capture: explicit` and `delivery: notice`.

Ordinary users never touch a config file: the panel asks one question — is **Smart memory** on (default yes)? When on, it probes common local embedding ports (llama-swap, Ollama, LM Studio…), uses whatever answers, and falls back to lexical matching without errors when nothing does. Endpoint, model, capture depth, delivery, notes per turn and consolidation sit under "Advanced" and save to `panel-settings.json` inside the memory folder.

**Remote embeddings?** Point the endpoint at any OpenAI-style `/v1/embeddings`, click "Fetch models" to list what the server reports (or type a name), then "Test connection" to verify dimensions and latency. Remote services need an API key (stored in `panel-settings.json`, a plain local file); the safer option is the `TABELLIO_SEMANTIC_API_KEY` environment variable — the panel then shows "Set" and never echoes the key.

- All reads and writes are local; network traffic is loopback only (local embeddings) plus one host-model judge call, which can be disabled.
- No telemetry is collected.
- Plain Markdown; keep it on a disk you trust and encrypt.

<details>
<summary>Architecture, tool surface, full config, tests and evaluation</summary>

- **Core `tabellio`**: storage, index, BM25 + co-occurrence scoring, write gate, receipts, consolidation. This plugin only adapts DSH; it does not duplicate core logic.
- **Adapter `tabellio-dsh`**: `agent/pre-step` recall, `agent/turn-stopping` capture, 7 native tools, settings panel (HTTP RPC with loopback + Origin checks: status, candidate approval, proposal approval, search, last recall, LLM judge).
- Switching hosts leaves the core untouched; only the adapter changes.

`tabellio_recall` / `tabellio_search` / `tabellio_read` / `tabellio_status` / `tabellio_capture` / `tabellio_inbox` / `tabellio_report` / `tabellio_conflicts` (read-only: probable stale pairs) / `tabellio_merge` (human-approved merge that retires the old notes) / `tabellio_feedback` (records "helpful / wrong" and nudges ranking only — never edits a note). `tabellio_recall` and `tabellio_search` accept `as_of` for point-in-time queries.. The tools share the same budget, refusal rules and write gate as the CLI and MCP server.

| Field | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | When off, no tools and no event handlers are registered |
| `storePath` | `~/memory/tabellio` | Same store as the CLI/MCP; `~` is expanded |
| `autoRecall` | `true` | Recall once per turn on the first human message |
| `shadow` | `false` | Write receipts only, never inject; useful for A/B |
| `delivery` | `notice` | `notice` shows a visible message; `context` injects silently |
| `recallBudgetTokens` | `1200` | Recall budget, 100–4000 (too small cuts gold below rank 2) |
| `recallMaxNotes` | `8` | Maximum notes, 1–20 |
| `recallIntentGate` | `true` | Do not inject when the question has no memory intent |
| `recallConfidentRelevance` | `0.9` | Bypass the intent gate when the top hit is at least this relevant |
| `feedbackRanking` | `true` | Apply small ranking nudges from helpful / wrong feedback (never adds or removes notes) |
| `recallTrusts` | `user_stated`, `system_derived` | Which sources auto-recall trusts; imported docs (`external`) stay searchable but are never injected by default |
| `recallMinCoverage` | `0.2` | Coverage gate (noise floor); abstention is left to the judge and the answer model |

`node tools/memory-eval.mjs` runs 12 fixed cases on a throwaway store across five capabilities: knowledge updates (2/2), temporal (2/2), preferences (2/2), project facts (2/2), and abstention (4/4). It scores correctness, not hit rate; `--strict` fails below the recorded baseline.
